name: Nutri choice 5 grain digestive
ingredients_raw: Wheat Flour (47%), Sugar, Vegetable Fat (Palm), Finger Millet Flour (8%), Oats Flakes (6%), Corn Flakes (6%), Wheat Bran (2.6%), Skim Milk Powder (1.7%) (From Cow's or Buffalo's Milk), Rice Flour (0.8%), Ammonium Bicarbonate (E503ii) & Sodium Bicarbonate (E500ii) (Raising Agents), Salt, Honey, Soya Lecithin (E322) (Emulsifier), Mono & Di Glycerides of Fatty Acids (E471) (Emulsifiers), Honey, Vanilla Cereal & Nut (Artificial Flavours)
